description: The plot shows how two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—vary with the recent sequence ratio, with perplexity mapped to the left y-axis and GPU memory ratio mapped to the right y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, spanning 0 to 100 with labeled ticks at 20-unit intervals (20, 40, 60, 80, 100). The left y-axis is labeled “Perplexity” on a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7 with ticks every 0.1, and the right y-axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” on a linear scale from 40 to 100 with ticks every 10. An orange solid line with circular markers (Perplexity) starts near 4.59 at 10%, decreases through about 4.45 at 20 and ~4.39 at 30 to a low around 4.30 at 40%, then rises to ~4.33 at 50 and ~4.34 at 60, dips to ~4.29 at 70, increases to ~4.33 at 80 and ~4.39 at 90, and ends near ~4.38 at 100%. A blue solid line with circular markers (GPU Mem. Ratio) begins around 41% at 10% recent sequence ratio, increases gradually to roughly 42% (20), 43% (30), 44% (40), 45% (50), 46% (60), and ~48% (70), reaches about 55% at 80%, then jumps to about 98% at 90% and ends near 99% at 100%. Two horizontal dashed reference lines are shown: a red dashed line labeled “Full Cache PPL” at approximately 4.38 on the perplexity axis, and a blue dashed line labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.” at 100% on the GPU memory axis; the legend appears near the upper center of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio, evaluated using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. The x-axis is labeled 'Recent Sequence Ratio (%)' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and the left y-axis is labeled 'Perplexity' with a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7. The right y-axis is labeled 'GPU Mem. Ratio (%)' with a linear scale from 40 to 100. The orange line, representing perplexity, begins at approximately 4.6 at 5% recent sequence ratio, decreases steadily to 4.2 at 40%, and then stabilizes before increasing slightly to 4.3 at 100%. The blue line, representing GPU memory ratio, starts at 40% at 5% recent sequence ratio and increases linearly to 80% at 100%. Two horizontal reference lines are included: a red dashed line at a perplexity of 4.4 labeled 'Full Cache PPL,' and a blue dashed line at a GPU memory ratio of 100% labeled 'Full Cache GPU Mem.' The legend is positioned at the top center of the plot.
